INTERNSHIP INTERVIEW 
MORGAN STANLEY 
ARCHEEL PAREKH, B. Tech. CS 2018-22 
 
●ROUND 1 (Online Test conducted on AMCAT) 
100 mins 
 
1. Aptitude Section (20 mins) 
Questions based on Probability, PnC and statistics. 
(I was not able to attempt a few of them) 
 
2. Debugging Section (20 mins) 
7 questions were asked and we had to select the 
programming language of our choice(C/C++/Java). 
Code with logical and syntax errors were given and we had 
to debug the code to get the desired output. 
(I was able to solve 6 questions and one partially) 
 
3. Coding Section (60 mins) 
3 coding questions were asked. 
(All questions had some story related to them. I am directly 
writing the coding problem related to the story) 
A. Given an array of integers of length N 
 Find indices of two elements A[i] and A[j] such that 
 j>i and A[j]<A[i] and  (j-i) should be maximum possible. 
B. Given N integers find the first K integers having 
maximum number of 1’s in their binary representation. 
C. This was some problem related to batch OS. 
Given N processes and their priorities, and how the 
processes are interdependent. We had to process all 
the interdependent processes together(in form of

batch). Priority of the batch is equal to the sum of all 
the processes present in it. We have to find the batch 
with maximum priority. 
(I was able to write a brute force solution for all the 
three problems. Few test cases didn't pass in all of them) 
This was all about the online round, 24 people were 
shortlisted for the next round. 
 
●ROUND 2 (Technical Interview) 
1 hour 
 
The interview started with me introducing myself. Then we 
talked a bit about my projects and internship. Then he directly 
started with DSA questions. 
I was asked 4 questions (3 algorithms and 1 question on 
OOPS) 
 
1. Given a binary matrix with sorted rows. Find the row with 
maximum 1’s. 
Solution​: 
https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/find-row-number-binary-ma
trix-maximum-number-1s/ 
I told him the brute force approach directly, and then I was 
able to give him the optimized O(m+n) approach directly 
since I had previously seen this problem. 
(He was satisfied with the logic and he didn't expect me to 
code this question) 
 
2. Given an array of integers, You have to make the array such 
that every alternate element is in increasing and decreasing 
order. 
Example​:

Input array : 1 2 5 9 17 13 6 3 
Output array : 1 5 2 17 9 13 3 6  
I told him the naive solution immediately, to sort the array 
and divide it into two parts and merge it to achieve such a 
fashion of elements in the array. Complexity O(nlogn). 
He told me to further optimize it and gave me some hints 
and I was able to come up with an O(n) solution. 
(I was asked to code this question) 
Solution​: 
https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/rearrange-array-maximum-
minimum-form/ 
 
3. Given an array of stock prices, write a program to trade to 
find the maximum profit. 
Solution​: ​https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/stock-buy-sell/ 
I was able to come up with a solution which failed a few dry 
runs and then I corrected it and told him the right solution 
O(n). 
4. He made me write some classes with inheritance and virtual 
function, and asked for the expected output. 
Follow up questions like how are virtual functions 
implemented and questions on function pointer and virtual 
tables were also asked. 
 
These were the questions asked to me.(I was not asked a 
single question on OS, DBMS :) Other interviewees were asked 
questions on DS, Os and DBMS in depth, so be prepared for it.) 
He was quite satisfied with the solutions. He then asked me 
if I had any questions.(Always ask something, it shows that you 
are interested) 
He was very friendly and discussed with me the projects he 
works on and other opportunities at Morgan Stanley. 
(10 students were selected for round 3)

●ROUND 3(Technical + HR Interview) 
30-40 mins 
It started with me introducing myself, my achievements, 
projects and internship.I was asked about what is CoC, what do 
we do, what was my role there. 
She then asked the design of the database for one of my 
projects and how to make API calls to other services. Asked 
about my role in group projects and what part of the project was 
done by me.(Be honest and don't fake about things you have not 
done) 
Then she asked me to remove duplicates from a 100GB file. 
I asked her for memory constraints if any! And she was happy 
when I asked, she was going to put the memory constraints later. 
(Always clarify the problem so that you can directly reach the 
correct solution without wasting time) 
Solution​:​https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/external-sorting/ 
Then she asked how to design a search engine. Follow up 
questions like what are the memory requirements, how the web 
crawler would work, what is reverse indexing, how will you further 
optimize the search engine were asked. 
I was then asked to design an online service for hospitals 
and patients to book an appointment. To which I replied “​I have 
already implemented this project during CoC’s inheritance 
program​”. I asked her if I can show her the website (hopefully 
this one was deployed). I shared my screen and navigated her 
through the website and explained its functioning. She was happy 
and asked me if it is commercially used!(I said to her it was just a 
prototype for learning purposes. A big thanks to CoC for 
conducting Inheritance Program ) 
She then asked me situational questions and then we were 
done with the interview. She asked me if I had any 
questions.(Always ask something!)

(8 students were selected for the internship and they played a 
prank on us XD.)
